info.name: Authorization Tokens Accounts Style Box API

params.name: id
params.description:
Specifies the investment to query. 
Morningstar Performance ID is the default identifer for the API. Use the Universe API to retrieve Performance IDs for investments in your entitled universe.

params.name: idType
params.description:
Specifies the type of the value passed in the `id` parameter.
Morningstar Performance ID is the default identifer for the API. Use the Universe API to retrieve Performance IDs for investments in your entitled universe.

params.name: baseCurrency
params.description: Base currency to use for investment lookup. Accepts 3‑character ISO 4217 currency codes.

params.name: domicile
params.description: Domicile to use for investment lookup. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes.

params.name: exchangeCountry
params.description: Exchange country to use for investment lookup. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes.

params.name: exchangeId
params.description: Exchange identifier to use for investment lookup.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Time series start date. Accepts `yyyy-MM-dd`.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Time series end date. Accepts `yyyy-MM-dd`.

items.docs: Most recent and time series data supported.

params.name: id
params.description:
Specifies the investment to query. 
Morningstar Performance ID is the default identifer for the API. Use the Universe API to retrieve Performance IDs for investments in your entitled universe.

params.name: regionId
params.description:
Filters style box breakpoints by region.

  * `1` = United States
  * `2` = Canada
  * `3` = Latin America
  * `4` = Europe
  * `5` = Japan
  * `6` = Australia/New Zealand
  * `7` = Asia excluding Japan
